correctness.rationale: The ordered four-time Wick and independent-Poisson-sign cumulants reduce to two explicit nonnegative kernels. Integrating over all 24 ordered chambers produces the exact fourth cumulants, and their strict difference has a positive integrand for every positive time. Dominated convergence gives finite positive per-time coefficients and the polynomial ratio. The conditional-Gaussian Fredholm determinant and the telegraph bounded-sign Schur estimate prove the precise exponential-moment domain separation. This reconstructs hypotheses, quantifiers, normalization and boundaries; 193 deterministic checks and independent Gaussian-operator trace comparisons corroborate finite cases without replacing continuum proofs. Sources: arxiv:2304.07738v1 (Eqs. 2, 11, 17 and S6-S15), RESULT.md, check.py.

value.rationale: Cocconi–Alston–Bertrand motivates transport analysis via the complete center-of-mass MSD; two distinct microscopic stiffness models can be tuned to have exactly the same entire MSD, so their pair correlations cannot identify the force mechanism. The exact fourth-displacement-cumulant ordering at every sampling duration resolves that physical identifiability gap with no arbitrary cutoff. Its universal rate ratio depends only on relaxation-rate geometry and not bare diffusion or force amplitude; different exponential-moment domains show a structural, experimentally consequential tail distinction. This is more than a re-expression of the known 2-point law. Limitations: stationary and unrepelled only, no noisy estimator theorem.
